6. Commit and push converter + converted materials (.mat + .meta) with a clear message. Exclude unrelated dirty vendor files.
7. Report: how many converted, known failures, next steps for Phase 6 readiness.

If bulk auto-convert is too risky/incomplete, ship a working editor menu Tools/Dark Matter Genesis/HDRP/Convert _Project Materials URP→HDRP and run it, documenting limitations.
